text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In the downtown district. Inari One and 
Twin Turbo were staring at a flyer posted 
on a certain 'run-down facility.'

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, we'll have to close up 
shop"...? Whoa, hold on, that's a huge 
crisis.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Like hell I can just leave it alone! Hey, 
Turbo! Let's save this bathhouse together!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Turbo's gonna save them too! Just 
like the goldfish!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. Truth is, the public 
bathhouse I always go to might be going 
out of business.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"That's why we're talkin' about shootin' a 
web promo video to bring customers pourin' 
in right now!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Brain cell explosion! Turbo has a great 
idea for the commercial!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
How about a super piping-hot, blazing 
sauna? It'll be so novel that tons of 
people will come!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds good! If we've got piping 
hot, might as well film an icy cold bath 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both of them seem like runaway types, with 
no one around to hit the brakes...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Turbo! Keep those ideas coming, 
and we'll make the ultimate commercial!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's go, let's go! Turbo at full 
throttleee!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And the commercial that was completed as 
a result...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaaaah, lately my fatigue just won't go 
away, it won't go awaaaaay! Take it away, 
Inari~!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah, to say goodbye to lingering fatigue!

text_block_list.name: Inari & Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yes, the public bath!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Once you rinse off in the hot water, sauna 
time comes first! Turbo, charge—☆!

text_block_list.name: Inari & Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ooooh, this place is...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It feels so damn good... my soul's just 
floating away, man.

text_block_list.name: Inari & Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ooooooh...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"The only proper way to wrap up a bath is 
with an Umanpy Orange!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If you get a winning stick, you get 10 
more☆

text_block_list.name: Inari & Turbo
text_block_list.text: Everyone! Make sure to come!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Chaos. It was pure chaos. And yet, the 
video's quality was extraordinarily high.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"How about that? I captured the absolute 
best expressions, especially inside the 
sauna, right?"
choice_data_list:
How did you manage to take a picture of a 
face like that?

How did you manage to take a picture of a 
face like that?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"That just takes a little clever 
ingenuity. After all, the more cornered 
Turbo gets, the better her game face is!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I kept the camera rolling during our sauna 
endurance match, and sure enough...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
That's Turbo for you. Whenever she's down 
and sulking in her room, she sometimes 
makes videos, you know?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I'm not feeling down! I'm just doing 
some needle-poking every time I think, 
'You big dummy!'

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're totally bummed out... Well, fine. 
Anyway—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Leave the mochi to the mochi maker! That's 
just the Inari One way of doing things!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought they were an uncontrollable 
runaway duo— but it turns out that's not 
quite the case.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while charging out in the lead, Inari 
One properly knows the right person for 
the right job...
choice_data_list: You've got a good eye for people, huh.

You've got a good eye for people, don't 
you?
That was like a pro's work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while charging out in the lead, Inari 
One properly knows the right person for 
the right job...
choice_data_list: You've got a good eye for people, huh.

You've got a good eye for people, don't 
you?
That was like a pro's work.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C-Cut it out... Turbo and I share a room, 
so of course I'd know that much, you 
dummy.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well, combining forces is important 
no matter what. Whether you're building a 
house or a castle—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It won't get built unless a whole bunch of 
craftsmen put their heads and hands 
together, after all.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Well, this should keep the bathhouse from 
going under. Alright Turbo, let's go take 
a dip!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Now we're good to go anytime again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the chaotic commercial video 
went viral, and the downtown bathhouse was 
saved.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that right, ain't that right? Well, 
I was mostly just dragging Turbo around, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Turbo takes all the credit this time! Well 
done, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, right? All thanks to Turbo, right? 
Just rely on me, and I'll do anything!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Never forgetting to give her partner 
credit, Inari One wasn't just all talk and 
momentum; she was a truly admirable 
leader.
